scope.objective: Mobile family shell and bounded local photo OCR, preserving family isolation and configurable comparator.
behaviors: Load the authenticated family profile or an empty onboarding state.
Configure name, postcode, selected stores and basket for that family.
Reject price collection until the profile is configured.
Keep real household data outside Git and publish only explicit synthetic examples.
Navigate five mobile views with truthful empty states.
Extract a photo without database writes, then explicitly review and save using idempotency.
Summarize confirmed stored receipts without claiming measured savings or physical stock.
exclusions: Reconstrucción aislada NOT_TESTED; sin nivel organizativo G1–G5
Sin despliegue ni migración de BD productiva
Consumo de inventario, congelador físico, menús y predicción pendientes
Sin garantía de stock ni seis cadenas conectadas
Sin certificación normativa ni auditoría de seguridad completa

authorization.source: Owner approved implementing the mobile family app based on supplied visual references, retaining private family profiles.
allowedActions: Implementación en rama y PR revisable
Pruebas sintéticas y consulta de escaparates públicos
authorization.executionPolicy: Sin despliegue, compra, pago, merge ni datos productivos; no eludir controles de acceso de fuentes.

limitations: Historical metadata/report text was privacy-redacted under owner instruction; not original byte-exact evidence.
This patch does not remove data from old Git commits or archived copies.

obligations.description: Interpretar líneas Makro con pesos y cantidades y reconciliar base neta con IVA declarado.
Mantener fecha desconocida pendiente en lugar de inventarla.
Conservar descripción e importes de líneas no normalizadas en la ingesta.
Aprender alias por coincidencia aceptada y reutilizarlos.
Guardar y consultar compra confirmada desde la aplicación/API.
Aislar datos y normalización entre familias.
Actualizar inventario mediante confirmación/evento sin duplicación.
Conservar transcripción manual sin afirmar ingreso en BD ni stock y reconciliar importes.

limitations: Historical reports are not a current 0.4.0 maturity evaluation.
Current qualification uses synthetic images and mocked browser APIs; real household images and production deployment are not qualified.
Trace retains two critical and two major legacy manual-transcription evidence gaps.

gaps.impact: Legacy global aliases lack family provenance.
gaps.closureCheck: Owner reviews legacy global aliases before shared use.
dependencies: Existing database operator review; no real DB migrated here.
